en: Color postcard view of a European city canal or river bend lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings. A low arched bridge crosses the water in the center. In the foreground there is a grassy park with benches where a few people sit, and a tourist boat full of passengers cruises along the water. Trees and lampposts border the park, and more greenery appears on the right. On the rooftop of one of the central buildings a sign with large letters is visible.
